desc: 花灰麻灰配炭黑罗纹，对镜自拍与袋口微距承载宽松慵懒日常
leaf: 女式宽松抓绒全拉链连帽卫衣
name: 花灰抓绒宽松全拉链帽衫款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代宽松廓形与全拉链门襟。
用对镜举机自拍的镜面瞬间完成社交语境代入，展示上身松弛比例。
用整片后背与立体双层帽片，证明廓形不塌、帽型有型。
用全敞开露出短内搭的叠穿站姿，演示一衣两穿的松弛比例。
用插袋瞬间的袋口、罗纹袖口与金属绳头微距，证明做工与实用细节。
收口促单，用折叠卫衣与内搭裤装的成套平铺给出直接照搬的穿搭答案。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless warm white studio sweep #F6F5F3 for figure frames with a soft wall shadow behind the shoulder, plain mirror-wall corner confined to the single selfie frame, pale heather field for the closing flat lay, no outdoor scenes
style.direction: effortless heather-grey oversized zip hoodie commerce
style.iconSystem: none; the set carries no icon language, structure comes from garment volume and hardware only
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio daylight near 5500K, broad wraparound fill that keeps the melange fleece texture readable, one gentle wall shadow for separation, phone-screen bounce inside the selfie frame only, never flat flash
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent effortless heather-grey oversized zip hoodie ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of heather fleece #C9C9C7, charcoal rib #26262A, warm white studio #F6F5F3 and caramel leather accent #A5714F; soft diffused studio daylight near 5500K with a broad wraparound fill keeping the melange texture readable plus one gentle wall shadow; warm white sweep, a mirror-wall corner only in the selfie frame and a pale heather field for the closing flat lay, no outdoor scenes; no rendered copy, no icon language; oversized dropped-shoulder silhouette over a black ribbed base, face obscured by phone or cropped from the chin down, structured double-layer hood; no color palette changes, no fitted silhouette, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no face or identity of the model
style.presentationRules: the hoodie always reads oversized with dropped shoulders over a black ribbed base, model generic and face obscured by phone or cropped from the chin down, hood panels keep their structured double-layer shape, hands relaxed in pockets or at the placket
style.surfaceSystem: brushed heather fleece face, dense rib cuffs and hem, matte metal zip teeth and aglets, black ribbed base layer, caramel leather strap accent, no denim, no technical shells
style.typography: no rendered copy in any frame; if a text slot is added it stays an empty placeholder rail
